annotations.title: Hold a time and text the link

description: Holds one open time from a quote for 10 minutes and has the shop text the person one link to book it. Use it only once the person has picked a price and a time, given their name and US mobile number, and said to go ahead. Side effect: the shop sends one text to that number. Nothing is booked until the person taps Book on the shop's page, where they also type their street address; you cannot book for them. Calling again with the same choice while the time is held sends no second text. The quote_id may come from any shop find_help or get_quote gave.

mobile.description: The person's US mobile number, with its area code, as they gave it. The shop texts it once.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it.

option_id.description: One of the quote's prices, by its option_id.

time_id.description: One of the quote's times, by its time_id.

name: hold_time

change.description: A change the person's assistant asked for once booked: a cancel (done at once, free under the shop's terms), or a move (the shop texted the person a link, and done once they picked a new time).

visit.description: The booked visit as it stands now: its time, its tech, and what has happened since the yes.

now.description: Where the visit has got to, from the tech's own taps and the visit's close.

promise.description: The time promised now, and how the arrival measured against it: open (its time has not ended), kept (arrived inside it), early or late (by minutes), missed, canceled, or unrecorded.
